error.skill.skillPackageMapper.parse.1.zh-CN: 技能文件缺少依赖名称，请补齐后再导入。
error.skill.skillPackageMapper.parse.1.en: The skill file is missing dependency names. Add them before importing.

error.skill.skillPackageMapper.text.1.zh-CN: 文件首行之后还需要填写技能执行指令。
error.skill.skillPackageMapper.text.1.en: Add the skill instructions after the first line.

error.skill.skillPackageMapper.invalid.1.zh-CN: 技能文件格式不正确或格式版本不受支持。
error.skill.skillPackageMapper.invalid.1.en: The skill file format is invalid or its version is unsupported.

error.skill.skillExecutionService.unavai.zh-CN: 所选技能不在该员工的可用能力中，请重新选择。
error.skill.skillExecutionService.unavai.en: The selected skill is not available to this AI employee. Select another skill.

error.skill.skillImportService.verifyPre.zh-CN: 文件内容或可用状态已经变化，请重新预览。
error.skill.skillImportService.verifyPre.en: The file content or availability has changed. Preview it again.

error.skill.skillImportTokenService.issu.zh-CN: 无法保存技能导入预览
error.skill.skillImportTokenService.issu.en: The skill import preview could not be saved.

error.skill.skillImportTokenService.inva.zh-CN: 技能导入预览已失效，请重新选择文件。
error.skill.skillImportTokenService.inva.en: The skill import preview expired. Select the file again.

text.skill.skillPromptMapper.append.1.zh-CN: 本次任务选择的技能，请按以下顺序应用：

text.skill.skillImportService.confirm.1.zh-CN: 导入的技能包含尚未匹配的插件，请选择需要的插件，或调整指令后保存草稿。
text.skill.skillImportService.confirm.1.en: The imported skill has unmatched plugins. Select the required plugins or adjust the instructions before saving the draft.

text.skill.skillImportService.confirm.2.zh-CN: 导入的技能包含尚未匹配的知识库，请选择需要的知识库，或调整指令后保存草稿。
